entities.subcategory: DeFi lending modular / fixed-rate / institutional DeFi
entities.catalyst: Robinhood Earn Jul 1 = mainstream retail adoption via USDG; Morpho Midnight fixed-rate Jul 18; BlackRock vault = institutional lending on-chain
entities.red_flags: Token MCap $1B vs TVL $7.5B = ratio baixo mas token liquidity reduzida; Morpho em competicao directa com Aave V4; smart contract risk em camada de lending
entities.source: https://morpho.org/blog (Morpho — Morpho Midnight Jul 18 e Robinhood Earn Jul 1 2026)

entities.access_note: disponivel em Coinbase / Kraken; MORPHO menos liquido que AAVE — ordem limitada
